reference_model.equilibrium: LTE with Debye-Huckel corrections in the source
reference_model.warning: Different closure and level cutoff from the seminar nonideal model; not an exact validation target for that model.

atomic_level_policy.source: User-supplied NIST ASD exports; extraction version/date unknown
atomic_level_policy.energies: Excitation energies relative to each charge-state ground level
atomic_level_policy.weight: g=2J+1, as parsed by the existing program
atomic_level_policy.bound_levels_only: Only E < I_bare retained; optional density-dependent cutoff requires a separate choice

source_DH_convention.do_not_double_count: Formation chemical-potential correction and altered level cutoff play different roles; do not add the same lowering twice to a Saha exponent.

diagnostic_coupling_parameters.note: Neither equals temperature ratio gamma_Te_Th. Neither is the seminar self-consistent regularized Gamma.

polarizability.source: Entropy 28(7),830 (2026), Table 4 and text before Table 1

ILJ_definition: V=D*[m/(n(x)-m)*x**(-n(x))-n(x)/(n(x)-m)*x**(-m)], x=r/Re, n=beta+4*x*x; charge exchange is not supplied by this potential alone

optional_polarization_model.status: candidate approximation; not a recovered MDPI table and not enabled implicitly
optional_polarization_model.basis: PPFM 0.2.0 src/Potential.cpp Polarization and analogous Ar-Ar2+ example in main.cpp
limitations: Only long-range induction; short-range scattering is unspecified
Not a tabulated momentum-transfer cross section or collision integral
No inelastic charge-transfer or excited-state-specific channels supplied

independent_transport_calculation.required_method: Chapman-Enskog mixture treatment with electron/heavy-species formulation, e.g. Devoto or Zhang-Murphy; choose orders and integral normalization consistently
independent_transport_calculation.not_included: A verified standalone Python implementation of the full transport solver
